events.title: Louisiana Purchase Transfer Ceremony in New Orleans
events.description: The United States formally took possession of the Louisiana Territory from France in a ceremony at the Cabildo in New Orleans, following the purchase agreed upon earlier that year.
events.significance: The transfer roughly doubled the size of the United States and opened the way for westward expansion across the North American continent.

events.title: South Carolina Secedes from the Union
events.description: A special convention in Charleston voted unanimously to adopt an Ordinance of Secession, making South Carolina the first state to leave the United States after Abraham Lincoln's election.
events.significance: The secession began the breakup of the Union and set in motion the events that led to the American Civil War in 1861.

events.title: Release of It's a Wonderful Life
events.description: Frank Capra's film starring James Stewart and Donna Reed premiered in New York City. It had modest initial box office returns but later gained wide popularity.
events.significance: The film became a beloved holiday classic and is regularly cited among the greatest American films ever made.

events.title: Elvis Presley Receives Draft Notice
events.description: Elvis Presley, already a major rock and roll star, was notified that he would be drafted into the U.S. Army. He was inducted in March 1958 and served until 1960.
events.significance: His military service drew huge public attention and marked a turning point in his career, showing how pop stars could be absorbed into mainstream American life.

events.title: Macau Returned to Chinese Sovereignty
events.description: Portugal handed over Macau to the People's Republic of China, ending more than four centuries of Portuguese presence, and it became a Special Administrative Region.
events.significance: It marked the end of one of the last European colonial holdings in Asia and followed the 1997 handover of Hong Kong under the 'one country, two systems' framework.
